implement_consumer_class: implement a Consumer subclass that accepts values from a finite stream and stores them
implement_consume_method: implement the consume method on a Consumer subclass to accept and process a single value
implement_terminate_method: implement the terminate method on a Consumer subclass to signal no more values will arrive
implement_consume_and_terminate_method: implement consume_and_terminate to supply a final value and signal stream completion in one call
review_consumer_interface: review the Consumer abstract base class and its three abstract methods for stream consumption
